errors.quote: Undoing the bank exchange gives all roles $C^{\otimes m}$.
errors.problem: The scalar network sends $(X_a,Y_a)\mapsto(-Y_a,X_a)$. Without negating the physical $X$ outputs, the $Y_a\to X_a$ route carries $-C^{\otimes m}$. The paper negates those outputs before sending $\rho(w)$ back to $w$ (\"undoing the signed bank exchange\").
